About us

Scented candles, no complications

We sell scented candles in a glass jar with a lid, all at the same price: 19.99 euros.

We chose twelve fragrances in six families, from the freshest to the warmest, made to scent your home in every season. No complicated price lists: pick the fragrance you like.

How we work

Three principles

Clear price
  • 19.99 euros for every candle
Simple choice
  • Twelve fragrances in six families
Protected scent
  • Glass jar with a lid
